decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-54 MODIFY already captures the national-brand positioning, color palette, and cross-location brand consistency; the visual-layout change requires no additional brand-identity state change.
The visual style and composition do not change the homepage section inventory or its information goal, which are independently established by the same source message.
The candidate already records the source message's independent mobile-friendly requirement; the visual-layout modification does not further change responsive behavior.
Changes to visual composition and brand presentation do not alter package catalogs or pricing consistency across locations.
The same source message separately establishes easy addition of future locations, and that impact is already represented; the visual-layout change adds no further expansion-state change.
The visual-layout modification does not affect domain routing, and the source message's independent master-domain change is already recorded.
The source visual changes do not alter location routing, selector placement, or selectable locations; the message's independent directory details are already represented.
The new visual direction does not necessarily change which legacy materials are reused or the purpose of that reuse.
Visual styling and national-brand presentation do not change the legacy site's transition availability or its master-site linkage.
The visual-layout modification does not revise the SEO-preservation goal or migration-handling requirements.
A consistent national visual presentation does not change the existing model in which each location has its own Wix website connected through the master site.
The source visual-layout and brand-presentation changes do not affect separate location calendars or their Wix-account placement.
